summary: Konami's tactical RPG series, covering the PlayStation/Saturn original, the PlayStation sequel, and the downloadable Flames of Judgment prequel.

entries.title: Vandal Hearts
entries.definitive_edition: Sega Saturn version for completeness; PlayStation for official English

emulation.emulator: Kronos, Mednafen Saturn, or DuckStation fallback for PlayStation
emulation.notes: Use Saturn emulation for the complete version; use PlayStation emulation if official English is required.

primary.why: The Saturn conversion is documented with added presentation and content, including a new rendered opening, animated cutscenes, multiple endings, additional playable characters, and new weapons and spells; it is the most complete version, while PlayStation is the official English route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Saturn version on hardware or a Saturn emulator if Japanese is acceptable; otherwise play the PlayStation version for official English and note the Saturn-exclusive additions separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official modern remaster documented; the canceled Nintendo DS project is not a released entry.

emulation.notes: Use accurate PS1 emulation with clean scaling.

primary.why: Vandal Hearts II is documented as a PlayStation-only sequel, so the original PlayStation release is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PlayStation hardware, PS3/PSP/Vita compatibility where owned, or an accurate PS1 emulator such as DuckStation.

entries.title: Vandal Hearts: Flames of Judgment

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if owned; RPCS3 may be used for legally dumped PSN content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: HD console output or emulator scaling.

primary.why: Flames of Judgment released for Xbox Live Arcade and PlayStation Network; the PS3 route is the most straightforward archival target thanks to PS3 hardware capture and RPCS3 documentation.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 if already purchased, or test a legally dumped PSN copy in RPCS3; use Xbox 360/XBLA only if that is the owned copy.

entries.remaster_caveats: Download-only prequel; storefront ownership/availability should be verified before planning coverage.
